Messages.Author: Kristyl Meth
Messages.Body:
Which types of cards does a diablerizing vamp inherit from the diablerized
vamp? I'm wondering if the diablerizing vamp has to take "non-favorable"
cards like Haven Uncovered or Fame or Rotschreck, etc....Does the
diablerizing vamp only get retainers and equipment?

KM

> >[when diablerizing a vampire who has been shackled,...]

> >diabolist have to take Shackles of Enkindu?
>
> If they chose to take the Shackles of Inky-Doo, which state would they
> be in? Shackling, or equipped waiting for you to use them?

Shackled. Once placed "on" a minion, the shackles will harm the
minion they are on.
